newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: AIB appoints Gary Kennedy financial director.
newsitem.headline: AIB appoints Gary Kennedy financial director.

text.p: Allied Irish Banks said on Monday that it has appointed Gary Kennedy, currently Vice President Enterprise Networks Europe and Managing Director Northern Telecom (Ireland) Ltd, as group financial director.
AIB said in a statement that Kennedy will take up his post as an Executive Director of AIB at the end of May 1997.
"We are very pleased at the prospect of Gary Kennedy joining our management team and board," Tom Mulcahy, AIB group chief executive, said.
"Gary's experience and background will provide an excellent complement to our existing team."
In September 1995 former financial director Kevin Kelly was appointed general manager AIB Bank but continued to hold the post until a suitable replacement was found, AIB said.

AIB said Kennedy, 39, a fellow of the Institute of Chartered Accountants in Ireland, is also a member of the board of industrial development agency IDA Ireland and of the national executive of the Irish Business and Employers' Confederation (IBEC).

He joined Northern Telecom in 1988 as financial manager and subsequently held a number of senior posts within that organisation, including that of financial director, before his appointment as managing director in 1992, AIB said.
